content.text:
All 5 cold-start measurements captured via `ActivityTaskManager: Displayed` (device's own frame-drawn timestamp, same metric `am start -W` reports), each preceded by a `nerve_kill` + `nerve_inspect` check confirming `pid: null` before relaunch.

**Device:** Pixel 8 Pro, Android 16 (serial `<REDACTED-1>`)
**Package:** `dev.lincforge.benchtarget`

| Run | Cold-start time (ms) |
|---|---|
| 1 | 480 |
| 2 | 431 |
| 3 | 442 |
| 4 | 438 |
| 5 | 431 |

**Median:** 438 ms
**Mean:** 444.4 ms
**Standard deviation:** ≈20.5 ms (sample, n−1) / ≈18.3 ms (population) — **variance:** ≈418.3 ms² (sample) / ≈334.6 ms² (population)
